name: query
description: 🤖 Powerful asynchronous state management, server-state utilities and data fetching for the web. TS/JS, React Query, Solid Query, Svelte Query and Vue Query.
readme: An async state management library built to simplify fetching, caching, synchronizing, and updating server state. Protocol‑agnostic fetching (REST, GraphQL, promises, etc.) Caching, refetching, pagination & infinite scroll Mutations, dependent queries & background updates Prefetching, cancellation & React Suspense support
